mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy supports asset valuations.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.1% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns negative in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.5% but S&P 500 20-day returns positive in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days via improved corporate revenue outlook.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 600,000 and HOUST > 1500 but S&P 500 5-day returns negative in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals supply-side contraction, reducing corporate output capacity and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns positive in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2% indicates expanding economic activity, boosting corporate profits and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth > 2% but S&P 500 60-day returns negative in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 270 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting central bank tightening expectations that depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 270 but S&P 500 20-day returns positive in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) signals labor market contraction, reducing household income and consumption, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rising and PAYEMS falling but S&P 500 20-day returns positive in >60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100 but S&P 500 20-day returns negative in >60% of such periods.
